senses.gloss:
मुड् r. 6th cl. (मुडति)
 1. To quit, to leave.
 2. To clothe or cover. (इ,)
मुडि r. 1st cl. (मुण्डते)
 1. To be pure or clean.
 2. To cleanse.
 3. To
sink, (as in water.)
 4. To sink, (in estimation.) to be despised
or disregarded. (मुण्डति)
 1. To shave or cut.
 2. To grind or pound.
